with.title: MiniMax M3.1 Flash open weights with day-one SGLang serving
MiniMax releases cheap M3.1 Flash with 1M context

possibilities.connection: M3.1 Flash was available as a cheap 1M-context API, and now its open weights serve on SGLang, so a product can move in-house without changing models.

possibilities.title: Inference resellers can quote open MoE serving on TPU capacity, not only GPUs

with.title: TorchTPU brings native PyTorch to Google TPUs
Reflection releases open-weight Beam 1.0, a 501B MoE

possibilities.connection: TorchTPU lets existing SGLang serving code run on TPUs, and Beam 1.0 is a speed-focused open MoE that teams can download and run, so one serving stack can now be priced on two kinds of hardware.
